last.verdict: Beat and raised guidance, but shares faded to a flat close.

reasons.label: Beat and raised outlook
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS $4.69 beat $4.14 estimate; 2026 guidance lifted to at least $20.50.

reasons.label: Shrinking membership
reasons.text: UnitedHealthcare served 48.3 million people, down from about 50.1 million a year earlier.

reasons.label: Early gains already faded
reasons.text: Shares were up 3–4.5% early, but the rally didn't hold into the close.

story: UnitedHealth fell about 20% in January after a weak revenue outlook and a near-flat Medicare Advantage rate proposal. Since then it has beaten estimates and raised guidance each quarter, with April up about 8% and July up sharply. This time the good news barely moved the stock.
